url.title: TikTok LIVE URL
url.description: Only public URLs in this format are supported: https://www.tiktok.com/@username/live.

durationMinutes.title: Capture duration (minutes)
durationMinutes.description: Capture duration, excluding initialWaitSeconds spent loading the LIVE room.

durationMs.title: Legacy parameter: capture duration (milliseconds)
durationMs.description: Kept for older calls. If provided, this takes precedence over durationMinutes. Use durationMinutes for new calls.

initialWaitSeconds.title: Initial room wait (seconds)
initialWaitSeconds.description: Wait for the page and chat to load. This wait is excluded from the capture duration.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Chat polling interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: Interval between checks for chat messages in the DOM. Shorter intervals capture messages sooner.

maxEvents.title: Maximum messages to save
maxEvents.description: Stop monitoring as soon as this limit is reached to avoid unbounded growth.

minMessageLength.title: Minimum message length (characters)
minMessageLength.description: Measured in Unicode characters. Set to 0 to disable length filtering.

deduplicate.title: Skip duplicate chat messages
deduplicate.description: Recommended to avoid saving the same visible message on repeated polls.

captureSecUid.title: Legacy parameter: attempt to read secUid (unavailable)
captureSecUid.description: Kept for older calls. TikTok chat DOM does not expose secUid, so this parameter cannot return it.
